reason: The IJCAI primary PDF describes AnoMamba for univariate and multivariate time-series anomaly detection. It uses patch embedding and global step-size reweighting; experiments use eight anomaly-detection benchmarks and report detection metrics plus efficiency. The inference operation is task-specific reconstruction scoring, with no language/LLM inference or serving evaluation.
title: AnoMamba: Aligning Reconstruction with Time Series Anomaly Detection via Selective Global Dependency Modeling
